description: Use this when the user wants a ready-made Discord server template, or a ready-made system for their server: a ticket panel, welcome message, announcement, giveaway, role menu or custom command. Also use it to show how other communities of the same kind (Minecraft, study group, roleplay, esports…) organize their server. Do not use it for general Discord questions or moderation help. It searches AiGuild's public template gallery and returns matching templates with how many servers installed them and a link to each template on aiguild.me. Nothing is created or changed. On aiguild.me the user signs in with Discord, reviews the template and applies it to a server they manage. To design a custom server structure instead, use preview_discord_server.

kind.description: server: a whole server (categories, channels, roles). ticket: ticket panel. welcome: welcome message. announce: announcement. giveaway. role_reaction: role menu. custom_command: custom command.

language.description: Language of the templates to search. Omit to search all languages.

query.description: Theme in a few words, e.g. minecraft survival, study group, support tickets. Leave empty for the most installed templates.

name: search_discord_templates
title: Search AiGuild's Discord templates
